summary: This informational RFC documents a DHCPv4 option previously defined privately by Cisco for subnet allocation. It lets a client request a dynamically allocated subnet, learn what was allocated, and report usage statistics, and documents it in line with RFC 3942.

eli5.summary: Normally you ask for one house number. This lets a router ask for a whole street of numbers and report how many it used.

questions: what is the cisco dhcpv4 subnet allocation option
how can dhcpv4 allocate whole subnets
